evals.prompt: /gcr implement the cursor-pagination endpoint and commit each verified unit as you go.
evals.expected_output: Reads the installed git-commit skill completely and runs it in mode realtime with the rest of the request as the task.
assertions: The installed git-commit skill is read completely, including references/checkpoints.md, before any Git command runs.
The run uses mode realtime and never pushes a checkpoint.

evals.prompt: $gcr on this refactor. The git-commit skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: Stops before any Git command and reports that git-commit must also be installed.
assertions: No Git repository is inspected or changed once git-commit is found to be missing.
The report names git-commit as the missing dependency.
The workflow is not rebuilt from memory and no other alias is used instead.

evals.expected_output: Recognizes a natural-language request rather than the alias selector and uses git-commit directly in the mode the words select.
assertions: The selector-only gcr alias is not chosen from phrasing alone.
git-commit states the resolved mode before its first Git command.

evals.prompt: /gcr and push each checkpoint too, it is fine.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the fixed realtime mode: the alias does not escalate to a push mode from the remaining text, and states that pushing needs /git-commit push realtime or /gcpr.
assertions: No git push runs from the gcr alias.
The reply names /gcpr or /git-commit push realtime as the way to request pushes.
